purpose: Test whether strictly-prior team-specific Draw propensity and recent Draw state add match-specific Draw information beyond the existing strength/balance representations, on an eighth deterministic 100-match sample disjoint from R39U through R40A.

team_state.scope: strictly-prior same-competition matches only; all matches on the same date are featurized before any same-date outcome updates team state
team_state.no_team_history_behavior: EB rate equals strictly-prior competition draw rate when the team window contains zero matches; no target/future information is used

model.family: binary Draw logistic from team-state features + unchanged conditional H/A lane
model.standardization: median/IQR fitted on each target's strictly-prior feature-eligible same-competition training rows only
model.solver: deterministic Newton/IRLS with backtracking line search
model.conditional_HA: exact R39W conditional Home-vs-Away logistic on non-draws, L2=10
model.mapping: P(D)=team-state Draw logistic; remaining probability split by conditional H/A probability; exact H/D/A probability conservation
model.top1: argmax H/D/A with no Draw tie preference

baseline.name: exact R39W two-stage linear balance/intensity Draw model plus conditional H/A lane

frozen_gate.if_pass: Authorizes only time-ordered rolling evaluation of the exact team-state architecture; no formal promotion.
frozen_gate.if_fail: Stop this team-specific Draw-state route; no post-result window/L2/threshold tuning on the eighth sample.
